# The whole encoder's corpus: pixels in, a JPEG file out.
#
# Every `file` here was **decoded by ffmpeg** when it was
# generated, with no warning and no error, and compared with the
# pixels that went in; the PSNR is on the case line. A wrong
# header, a wrong length field, a wrong Huffman code or absent
# byte stuffing does not make a worse picture, it makes a file
# nothing opens -- so a case that survives that round trip is a
# strong statement, and this file is what lets the gate make it
# without ffmpeg installed.
#
# Generated out of tree, the way testdata/ip/inflate_corpus.txt
# and testdata/ip/adpcm_corpus.txt are.
#
#   case   <name> <width> <height> <psnr ffmpeg measured>
#   qtable <64 bytes, hex, in DQT order>
#   pixels <the samples, hex, block by block and row-major in each>
#   file   <the whole JPEG, hex>
#
# The Huffman tables are Annex K's, shared by every case, in the
# form DHT carries them: a count of codes per length, then the
# symbols.

dcbits 00010501010101010100000000000000
dcvals 000102030405060708090a0b
acbits 0002010303020403050504040000017d
acvals
